focus.name: progressive-palette-services
focus.purpose: Bound the complete palette transition variants adjacent to the shared palette-step and scene-transition helpers without promoting overlapping alternate entries.

targets.name: Render_RunProgressivePaletteTransition
targets.contract: Initialize four palette-band pointers, snapshot 64 current palette words, clear the convergence index, then run 47 VBlank-paced transition iterations.

targets.name: Render_ConvergePaletteWordsByProgress
targets.contract: Move each selected current palette word toward the source by one masked component step, using 0x00FFEFF6 as the inclusive word-count index, and write the result through VDP_DATA.

targets.name: Render_ConvergePaletteBandFromBlack
targets.contract: Clear a 16-word working band and perform 16 VBlank-paced positive component-step passes at VDP palette address 0xC020.
